# Health Plus International

> Health Plus International is a healthcare workforce development organisation building qualification-aligned pipelines through verified readiness, role-based development and retention support, with a focus on New South Wales.

Official website: https://healthplusint.com.au/
Last updated: 2026-10-01

## Important boundaries

HPI does not guarantee a worker, job, interview, visa, registration result, start date, placement or retention outcome. Role, credential, employer, location and service requirements must be verified. The employing or host facility remains the Employer of Record and retains clinical governance, workplace, induction, supervision, scope and selection decisions within its authority.
